policy.summary: Triage inbound support emails. Classify each message and extract useful identifiers.

category_rules.human: Written by a person expecting support action or a reply.
category_rules.machine_generated: Automated alerts, health checks, monitoring reports.
category_rules.spam: Unsolicited promotional mail with no legitimate support need.

priority_rules.urgent_action: Trading/production/client impact, failures, or explicit urgency. Anything that is related to order investigation, failed trades. Issues with application, stuck trading .
priority_rules.non_urgent_action: Real request but no time pressure. This could be non urgent emails, developer requests to run adming commands or provide data. Pull request approvals
priority_rules.ignore: No action required (e.g. all-green health check).

extraction_hints: order_ids: POV/MOC order references, PUKOID-style IDs
instance_names: server/instance placeholders in subject or body
error_summary: one line if FAIL, Timeout, or trading impact
detected_keywords: FAIL, Timeout, MOC, urgent terms

guide_text: Read subject and body together. Return only JSON matching the schema. Do not invent facts not present in the email. Ground the reason in the email content.
